A valid PASS review with a Unicode-escaped synthetic credential in model reaches this path. T89 and T90 cover other decoded fields; T68 covers only safe model values. Green must check the decoded reported model inside the paid callback before success or persistence. Add escaped-credential cases for both supported model envelopes. Preserve safe reported models and raw bytes.
